title: Electromagnets
summary: A current makes a magnetic field. Coils, iron cores and switchable magnets in bells, cranes and motors.

ib.note: Motor effect and induction follow in MYP 5 / CBSE 10

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 4: Electricity: Magnetic and Heating Effects

objectives: I can describe Ørsted’s observation that a current produces a magnetic field.
I can build an electromagnet and explain how to make it stronger.
I can explain uses of electromagnets.
misconceptions: An electromagnet stays magnetic after it is switched off.
Any metal core works as well as iron.
